strategy.name: intraday_sma_or_flat_start_reentry_grid
strategy.description: 按用户随机指定的 2010-01-01 至 2015-06-01 区间复测同一策略；因 2010-01-01 休市，实际观察从 2010-01-04 开始。初始持有现金，等待第一个普通买入信号后全仓持有 QQQ；持仓时由成本止损、短均线慢性转弱、SMA25/30/35 当日变化率同时快速转弱或 SMA200 下穿中的任一规则全仓卖出；空仓时由卖出价上方强制买回、SMA200 上穿或短均线恢复中的任一规则全仓买回。扫描 R=0% 至 10%。
strategy.buy_rule: 初始空仓且没有上次卖价，因此仅允许动态 SMA200 上穿或短均线恢复产生第一笔买入；以后空仓时再额外允许价格达到上次实际卖出价的 1+R。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓时 OR：成本价 -1.5%；短均线平均变化率此前连续 6 日为负且当日仍为负并跌破动态 SMA130；此前连续 2 日短均线平均变化率为负且当日动态 SMA25、SMA30、SMA35 各自变化率全部不高于 -0.20%；动态 SMA200 下穿。
strategy.signal_time: 每个交易日开始前，仅用截至前一交易日 Close 的历史计算该日条件单及动态阈值公式；盘中是否触发由该日常规时段调整后 OHLC 判定。
strategy.execution_time: 若前 Close 到当日 Open 已越过阈值，按当日 Open；否则常规时段 OHLC 触及阈值时按精确理论阈值；零滑点、零费用；每天最多一笔成交。
strategy.position_sizing: long-only，初始 100,000 美元现金；触发后全仓持有或全现金，允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.initial_position: 2010-01-04 起空仓等待；第一笔正常买入成交前不计入策略与 Buy & Hold 的正式比较区间。

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: At the strategy's first actual buy fill, invest the same 100,000 USD in QQQ at that identical fill price; compare both paths only from that date through 2015-06-01 Close.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v3 unchanged because this is the same strategy and report interaction contract with only a different analysis interval.

research.hypothesis: A randomly selected earlier interval can reveal whether the R response and risk improvement observed after 2021 persist outside that period.
research.primary_metric: Report all R=0% through 10% results for total return, CAGR, Sharpe, maximum drawdown, exposure and trade count against the common-entry QQQ benchmark.
research.selection_rule: No parameter is selected or promoted. R=5% is predeclared only as the trade-marker display case; sample extrema are descriptive.
research.validation_plan: Every R case must match PyBroker and the independent ledger and share the same first ordinary buy fill; the requested holiday start is normalized explicitly to 2010-01-04.
research.promotion_criteria: None. This interval check may inform later walk-forward design but cannot promote a parameter by itself.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject if the run starts before an ordinary buy, treats 2010-01-01 as a trading day, changes any non-date strategy parameter, uses different benchmark entry, trades more than once per day, or diverges from the independent ledger.
